courses.overview: 由南北島能源互補與資產更新延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend island energy complementarity and asset renewal into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 日本北海道本州高壓直流連線案例
related.why: 兩個島嶼案例都用 HVDC 增加調度選擇。
related.whyEn: Both island cases use HVDC to increase dispatch options.
related.transfer: 兩個島嶼案例都用 HVDC 增加調度選擇。
related.transferEn: Both island cases use HVDC to increase dispatch options.
related.difference: 新北本含 2019 VSC 增建；紐西蘭需要區分長期極線更新。
related.differenceEn: New Hokkaido includes a 2019 VSC addition; New Zealand has multiple pole-renewal eras.
practice: 把「1965 起點」的概念圖與「日本北海道本州高壓直流連線案例」的輸入輸出對照。
分段標示資產型態與環境限制。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：新北本含 2019 VSC 增建；紐西蘭需要區分長期極線更新。
practiceEn: Compare the 1965 beginning concept map with inputs/outputs of Hokkaido-Honshu HVDC interconnection case study.
Label asset types and environmental constraints by segment.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: New Hokkaido includes a 2019 VSC addition; New Zealand has multiple pole-renewal eras.

related.title: 英法海峽 IFA 互連電網案例
related.why: IFA 和南北島連線都需海纜資產維護與可用性規劃。
related.whyEn: IFA and the inter-island link need cable-asset maintenance/availability planning.
related.transfer: IFA 和南北島連線都需海纜資產維護與可用性規劃。
related.transferEn: IFA and the inter-island link need cable-asset maintenance/availability planning.
related.difference: 跨國交易與國內水力互補的需求情境不同。
related.differenceEn: Cross-border trade and domestic hydro complementarity have different needs.
practice: 把「水力互補」的概念圖與「英法海峽 IFA 互連電網案例」的輸入輸出對照。
以來源年份核對極線名稱與事件。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：跨國交易與國內水力互補的需求情境不同。
practiceEn: Compare the hydro complementarity concept map with inputs/outputs of IFA cross-Channel interconnector case study.
Check pole names/events against dated sources.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Cross-border trade and domestic hydro complementarity have different needs.

history.title: 跨島連線與極線更新
history.text: 紐西蘭電力管理局記錄 1965 年起始與 2013 年 Pole 3 替代的歷史；不同年代的容量數字不可混成現況。
history.textEn: New Zealand’s Electricity Authority documents the 1965 beginning and 2013 Pole 3 replacement; ratings from different eras must not be merged into a current status.

history.title: 海纜更新仍是計畫時程
history.titleEn: Cable renewal remains a planned timeline
history.text: Transpower 的 2026 合約公告說明預計 2031 年鋪纜及 2032 年上半年投運；這是公告時的計畫，不是已完成工程。它與較早更新頁面的時程須保留版本差異。
history.textEn: Transpower’s 2026 contract notice plans cable installation in 2031 and commissioning in the first half of 2032. This is the plan at publication, not completed work; retain differences from earlier programme pages.

roles.role: 紐西蘭 HVDC 資產擁有者與營運者，可對照資產更新。
roles.roleEn: Owner and operator of New Zealand's HVDC assets, relevant to asset renewal.
roles.business: 紐西蘭國營輸電營運商，管理南北島 HVDC 資產。
roles.businessEn: New Zealand's state-owned transmission operator, managing the inter-island HVDC assets.

roles.role: 提供 HVDC 換流系統，可對照南北島能源互補。
roles.roleEn: Supplies HVDC converter systems, relevant to inter-island energy complementarity.
roles.business: 燃氣／汽輪機與發電機、HVDC 與 FACTS、變壓器、風機與電解槽。
roles.businessEn: Gas/steam turbines and generators, HVDC and FACTS, transformers, wind turbines and electrolyzers.

roles.role: 旗下 Hitachi Energy 提供 HVDC 系統，可對照本課的換流技術比較。
roles.roleEn: Its Hitachi Energy unit supplies HVDC systems, relevant to converter-technology comparison here.
roles.business: 日立集團母公司；旗下 Hitachi Energy 提供 HVDC、變壓器與電網設備，Hitachi High-Tech 提供量測與蝕刻設備。
roles.businessEn: Parent of the Hitachi group; Hitachi Energy supplies HVDC, transformers and grid equipment, and Hitachi High-Tech supplies metrology and etch tools.

courses.connection: 從「紐西蘭 HVDC Inter-Island 連線案例」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in New Zealand HVDC Inter-Island link case study. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
